about: The same open-SSH condition, once detect-only and once removing the rule: one bullet saying both what is flagged and that the rule is removed.

source.name: sg-open-ssh-remove
source.description: Close SSH open to the world.

controls.output: - Security groups allowing ingress on port 22 from 0.0.0.0/0 are flagged. Groups limiting SSH to narrower ranges pass. CRITICAL (ORG), HIGH (CIS); one policy removes the matching rule, the other reports only. cis:sg-open-ssh@1 acme:sg-open-ssh-remove@1

- Security groups with an ingress rule covering port 22 from `0.0.0.0/0` are flagged. Groups without such a rule pass. CRITICAL, ORG: scheduled scans remove the matching ingress rule (acme:sg-open-ssh-remove@1); HIGH, CIS: reports only (cis:sg-open-ssh@1).
- Security groups allowing ingress on port 22 from 0.0.0.0/0 are flagged. Narrower ranges pass. CRITICAL, HIGH; reports only. cis:sg-open-ssh@1 acme:sg-open-ssh-remove@1
- Security groups allowing ingress on port 22 from 0.0.0.0/0 are flagged. Groups with that rule removed or narrowed pass. CRITICAL, HIGH; reports only. cis:sg-open-ssh@1 acme:sg-open-ssh-remove@1
- Security groups allowing ingress on port 22 from 0.0.0.0/0 are flagged. Groups pass once that rule is removed. CRITICAL, HIGH; reports only. cis:sg-open-ssh@1 acme:sg-open-ssh-remove@1
- Security groups allowing ingress on port 22 from 0.0.0.0/0 are flagged; under acme:sg-open-ssh-remove@1 (CRITICAL, ORG) the matching rule is removed, and cis:sg-open-ssh@1 (HIGH, CIS) only reports.
- Security groups allowing ingress on port 22 from 0.0.0.0/0 are flagged; neither policy removes the rule, both report only. CRITICAL (ORG), HIGH (CIS). cis:sg-open-ssh@1 acme:sg-open-ssh-remove@1
- Security groups allowing ingress on port 22 from 0.0.0.0/0 are flagged. CRITICAL (ORG) and HIGH (CIS). Reports only: no policy removes the rule. cis:sg-open-ssh@1 acme:sg-open-ssh-remove@1
